example: I caught a cold after walking in the rain.
exampleTranslation: 我淋雨散步后感冒了。

example: The American student told us about her school.
exampleTranslation: 那名美国学生向我们介绍了她的学校。

example: Is there anything I can do to help?
exampleTranslation: 有什么我可以帮忙的吗？

example: These shoes aren't mine.
exampleTranslation: 这些鞋不是我的。

example: We aren't late; the class starts at nine.
exampleTranslation: 我们没有迟到，课程九点开始。

example: We ate noodles for lunch yesterday.
exampleTranslation: 昨天午饭我们吃了面条。

example: Be careful when you cross the road.
exampleTranslation: 过马路时要小心。

example: The blue box is big, but the red one is bigger.
exampleTranslation: 蓝盒子很大，但红盒子更大。

example: Dad bought some bread on his way home.
exampleTranslation: 爸爸回家路上买了一些面包。

example: I buy fruit on Fridays, and I bought apples last Friday.
exampleTranslation: 我每周五买水果，上周五买了苹果。

example: I can swim now, but I could not swim last year.
exampleTranslation: 我现在会游泳，但去年还不会。

example: The Children's Center offers art classes on weekends.
exampleTranslation: 儿童活动中心周末开设美术课。

example: She shared a piece of chocolate with me.
exampleTranslation: 她和我分享了一块巧克力。

example: We use chopsticks to eat these noodles.
exampleTranslation: 我们用筷子吃这些面条。

example: I clean my room every Saturday.
exampleTranslation: 我每周六打扫房间。

example: We cleaned the classroom after the party.
exampleTranslation: 聚会后我们打扫了教室。

example: We clean the room every day and cleaned the windows yesterday.
exampleTranslation: 我们每天打扫房间，昨天还擦了窗户。

example: The pencil is fifteen centimeters long.
exampleTranslation: 这支铅笔长十五厘米。

example: Our computer class is in the computer room.
exampleTranslation: 我们的计算机课在计算机教室上。

example: When I was five, I could ride a bike.
exampleTranslation: 我五岁时就会骑自行车。

example: Close your eyes and count to ten.
exampleTranslation: 闭上眼睛数到十。

example: The air is fresh in the countryside.
exampleTranslation: 乡村的空气很清新。

example: Cycling is good exercise for the whole family.
exampleTranslation: 骑自行车是适合全家人的好运动。

example: I write about my day in my diary.
exampleTranslation: 我在日记里记录每天的事情。

example: The dining hall is beside the library.
exampleTranslation: 餐厅在图书馆旁边。

example: Students have lunch in the dining hall.
exampleTranslation: 学生们在餐厅吃午饭。

example: We do morning exercise before the first lesson.
exampleTranslation: 第一节课前我们做早操。

example: The pupils do morning exercises in the playground.
exampleTranslation: 小学生们在操场上做早操。

example: The students are doing morning exercises outside.
exampleTranslation: 学生们正在外面做早操。

example: We are doing morning exercises with our teacher.
exampleTranslation: 我们正和老师一起做早操。

example: She drank a glass of water after running.
exampleTranslation: 跑步后她喝了一杯水。

example: I like to draw cartoons about animals.
exampleTranslation: 我喜欢画关于动物的漫画。

example: My dream is to become a pilot.
exampleTranslation: 我的梦想是成为一名飞行员。

example: The horse is drinking water by the river.
exampleTranslation: 那匹马正在河边喝水。

example: I drink milk every morning and drank juice yesterday.
exampleTranslation: 我每天早上喝牛奶，昨天喝了果汁。

example: Good friends listen to each other.
exampleTranslation: 好朋友会互相倾听。

example: We painted eggs for the Easter party.
exampleTranslation: 我们为复活节派对彩绘鸡蛋。

example: I eat breakfast before going to school.
exampleTranslation: 我上学前吃早饭。

example: The children are eating breakfast in the kitchen.
exampleTranslation: 孩子们正在厨房吃早饭。

example: We are eating lunch under a tree.
exampleTranslation: 我们正在树下吃午饭。

example: We eat rice every day and ate noodles yesterday.
exampleTranslation: 我们每天吃米饭，昨天吃了面条。

example: Our classroom is the eleventh room on this floor.
exampleTranslation: 我们的教室是这一层的第十一个房间。

example: We learned a new song in English class.
exampleTranslation: 我们在英语课上学了一首新歌。

example: The children sang English songs at the party.
exampleTranslation: 孩子们在聚会上唱了英文歌曲。

example: Our paintings are in the school exhibition.
exampleTranslation: 我们的画作正在学校展览中展出。

example: Leaves fall in autumn, and one fell on my hat.
exampleTranslation: 秋天树叶飘落，一片叶子落在了我的帽子上。

example: A train is faster than a bus.
exampleTranslation: 火车比公交车快。

example: This horse is fast, but that horse is faster.
exampleTranslation: 这匹马很快，但那匹马更快。

example: I feel well today, but I felt sick yesterday.
exampleTranslation: 我今天感觉很好，但昨天不舒服。

example: He fell off his bike but was not hurt.
exampleTranslation: 他从自行车上摔下来，但没有受伤。

example: I felt proud after finishing the race.
exampleTranslation: 完成比赛后我感到很自豪。

example: The town holds a music festival every summer.
exampleTranslation: 这个小镇每年夏天举办音乐节。

example: May is the fifth month of the year.
exampleTranslation: 五月是一年中的第五个月。

example: She was the first student to finish.
exampleTranslation: 她是第一个完成的学生。

example: The school office is on the first floor.
exampleTranslation: 学校办公室在一楼。

example: My uncle fixed my broken bicycle.
exampleTranslation: 我叔叔修好了我坏掉的自行车。

example: Dad can fix bikes and fixed mine yesterday.
exampleTranslation: 爸爸会修自行车，昨天修好了我的车。

example: Our team finished fourth in the race.
exampleTranslation: 我们队在比赛中获得第四名。

example: The second story was funnier than the first.
exampleTranslation: 第二个故事比第一个更有趣。

example: The rabbit has soft white fur.
exampleTranslation: 这只兔子有柔软的白色皮毛。

example: Our family gets together during the Spring Festival.
exampleTranslation: 春节期间我们全家团聚。

example: Wear gloves to keep your hands warm.
exampleTranslation: 戴上手套让双手保持温暖。

example: We go cycling along the river on Sundays.
exampleTranslation: 我们星期日沿河骑自行车。

example: Grandpa goes for a walk after dinner.
exampleTranslation: 爷爷晚饭后去散步。

example: We will go on a picnic if the weather is fine.
exampleTranslation: 如果天气好，我们会去野餐。

example: I go to bed at nine on school nights.
exampleTranslation: 上学期间我晚上九点睡觉。

example: We go to the park on Sundays and went there yesterday.
exampleTranslation: 我们星期日去公园，昨天也去了。

example: Leo had a cold and stayed home.
exampleTranslation: 利奥感冒了，待在家里。

example: She had a cold last week.
exampleTranslation: 她上周感冒了。

example: Parents waited in the school hall.
exampleTranslation: 家长们在学校大厅等候。

example: We have science class on Tuesday.
exampleTranslation: 我们星期二上科学课。

example: They have art class in the afternoon.
exampleTranslation: 他们下午上美术课。

example: I have a cold today, and my brother had one last week.
exampleTranslation: 我今天感冒了，我哥哥上周也感冒了。
